- unit-node: 2719 passed, 3 failed.
- unit-web: 1786 passed, 1 failed.
- formula: 259 passed, 2 skipped.
- All four failures are timeouts (one at 30 s, three at 5 s), in files I didn't touch:
  - `architecture.test.ts`
  - `server.test.ts`
  - `branding-layout.test.ts`
  - `ExecutionPanel.test.tsx`

I did not re-run them on their own.

**Full integration suite: no result.** It was killed at the 2-hour limit partway through, so there is no final count.
- The partial log shows 1,227 passing test lines and 7 failures.
- `register-filters.test.ts` ran and passed 13/13.
- `initiatives-filters.test.ts` had not run yet when it was killed.
- Three failures are timeouts: form export at 60 s, and two `contract.test.ts` sweeps at 30 s.
- Four are assertion failures, all in areas I didn't touch: the worker event-to-queue registry, the 0116 catalogue triggers, the KPI freshness scan, and the P5 BE-J contract exercises. I did not check whether they also fail on the base commit `ff1e975`.

The full integration count has to come from your merged-tree run. I have not restarted the chain, because it had already used the longest background time allowed.
